The projection therefore names `authority:guardian-1201` as `sharing_controller`, while its schedule controller remains the organizer.

Sensitivity attaches independently to fields and relationships. The guardian relationship itself is `restricted_family`; `contact_email` (`river.k@example.com`) and `precise_handoff_place` are `restricted`, while the display alias is `shareable`. Public export excludes guardian relationship notes and inferred assessments. It withholds `/subject/internal_id`, `/subject/contact_email`, `/handoff/precise_place`, `/guardian/relationship_notes`, and `/subject/inferred_assessments`; records redacted fields `contact_email`, `precise_handoff_place`, `guardian_relationship_notes`, and `inferred_assessments`; and applies transforms `replace_internal_identity_with_public_alias` and `withhold_precise_handoff_place`.
